title: Extradition fight and 'we want to see him fry' embassy meeting

tellings.quote: Ed Gibson, who was a tache to the US embassy in London at the time, met with my lawyer and he said, "We want to see him fry." Electric chair reference.

plain: While Gary McKinnon, a British hacker who says he found signs of a secret NASA space programme, was fighting extradition to the United States in the 2000s, a US official said they wanted him executed, according to McKinnon himself. He tells Michels that Ed Gibson, an attaché at the US embassy in London, met his lawyer and said, 'We want to see him fry', which McKinnon takes as an 'electric chair reference'.
